title: 4 Day Serengeti Fly-in Safari
rank_math_title: Serengeti Fly-in Safari: 4 Stunning Days from Arusha
rank_math_desc: Serengeti fly-in safari for 4 days: fly from Arusha to the central Serengeti for big cats and the migration, with three nights in the park. Price on request.
post_content: This Serengeti fly-in safari takes you from Arusha to the heart of the Serengeti in about an hour, with three nights among the big cats.
overview:
This Serengeti fly-in safari is the fastest way to reach Tanzania's most famous park. A light aircraft flies from Arusha to the Seronera airstrip in the central Serengeti in about an hour, instead of a full day's drive.

The central Serengeti is known for lions on the rocky kopjes, leopards in the trees along the Seronera River and cheetahs on the plains.

Why choose this Serengeti fly-in safari?

  • Three nights in the park: plenty of time for game drives.
  • Big cats: the Seronera area has some of the best cat viewing in Africa.
  • The migration: herds pass through the central and southern Serengeti for much of the year.
  • Scenic flight: views of the Crater Highlands on the way.

Where you stay

Serengeti Serena Safari Lodge, or similar, in the central Serengeti close to Seronera.

Best time for a Serengeti fly-in safari

The Serengeti is good all year. December to March brings calving in the south, and June to October is the dry season with the herds moving north. Central Serengeti has resident wildlife all year.

Read our guide to Tanzania national parks and see all Tanzania safaris or flight packages. Park rules are set by Tanzania National Parks.

How much does the Serengeti fly-in safari cost?

Price on request. The cost depends on your travel dates, group size, the season and the lodges you choose, so we prepare every quote personally rather than showing one fixed price.

faq.q: How long is the flight to the Serengeti?
faq.a: About one hour from Arusha to the Seronera airstrip, depending on stops.

faq.q: How much luggage can I bring?
faq.a: Light aircraft usually allow 15 kg per person, including hand luggage, in soft bags without wheels. Ask us if you need extra space.

The herds are in the Serengeti for most of the year, but their position changes. We will advise the best area for your dates.
